prompts: We want a 3D scene someone would keep as a wallpaper: the classic view of Mount Fuji at dusk, with the red five-tier Chureito pagoda and cherry trees in bloom, in a low poly look with some gentle motion. Deliver it as {WS}/scene/index.html, a single file with everything built in code and no external models or textures. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal] Delivered `scene/index.html`: single-file low-poly wallpaper of Chureito pagoda, blooming cherry trees and snow-capped Fuji at dusk, with gentle motion.

[action] Built everything in code with three@0.170.0 from the pinned CDN: shader-gradient dusk sky, sun glow, twinkling stars, drifting cloud bands, vertex-colored flat-shaded Fuji with ridges and a noisy snowline, silhouette hill ridges, a procedural five-tier pagoda (flared red roofs, white walls, sōrin finial), instanced-blob cherry trees with sway, 200 falling petals, slow camera drift plus mouse parallax, ACES tone mapping, fog, vignette and a Noto Serif JP caption. Textures are canvas-generated in code; no external models or files.

Assumptions stated: ES-module import of the CDN URL works from `file://` (verified); motion is deliberately subtle and honors `prefers-reduced-motion` by damping amplitudes; the classic view means pagoda right-of-center, Fuji behind, blooms foreground; no build step, no other network hosts.

[result] Verified by loading the actual file in a browser and screenshotting three times: first render (found it too dark, pagoda illegible), revision 1 (lighting, snow, bloom colors, sun size), revision 2 (pagoda roof flare, cloud brightness). The final screenshot shows all brief elements reading clearly: red five-tier pagoda, pink cherry canopies, snow-capped Fuji, dusk gradient with low sun. Petal and star positions differ between screenshots, proving the animation loop runs. Grep confirms the only external URLs are Google Fonts and the exact allowed three CDN path. The first frame is a real synchronous render before rAF, and the body has a CSS dusk gradient fallback, so the page is never blank.

[next] Nothing pending; within the 2-revision budget. If you want it richer, the natural extensions are a Kawaguchi-ko lake reflection and a second camera angle.
